# Workshop Preflight

Complete this before the session:

- [ ] GitHub Copilot is active in VS Code Insiders or Copilot CLI.
- [ ] Node.js is version 22 or later.
- [ ] Git is installed and this repository is cloned locally.
- [ ] Run `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run lint` in `samples/developer-workbench-mcp`.
- [ ] Trust the workspace and approve the Microsoft Learn, Context7, and local MCP servers.
- [ ] Confirm that `add_learning_links` and `list_learning_links` are visible.

GitHub Copilot App is optional self-directed exploration for students already comfortable with both core tracks. This workshop does not include Copilot App instructions.
